twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on
twoFactorEnabled.preview: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your account.
twoFactorEnabled.heading: Two-factor authentication is on
twoFactorEnabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your {instance} account on {date}. You will now need your authenticator app or a security key to sign in.
twoFactorEnabled.recovery: Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe. They are the only way in if you lose your device.
twoFactorEnabled.notYou: If you did not do this, secure your account now and contact {contact}.
twoFactorDisabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off
twoFactorDisabled.preview: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your account.
twoFactorDisabled.heading: Two-factor authentication is off
twoFactorDisabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your {instance} account on {date}. Your account is now protected by your password alone.
twoFactorDisabled.notYou: If you did not do this, change your password now and contact {contact}.
newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your {instance} account
newSignIn.preview: Your account was signed in to from a new device.
newSignIn.heading: New sign-in from a new device
newSignIn.body: Your {instance} account was signed in to from a device we have not seen before.
newSignIn.itWasYou: If this was you, there is nothing to do.
newSignIn.notYou: If this was not you, sign out that session and change your password.
streamKeyRevoked.subject: Your stream key for {channel} was revoked
streamKeyRevoked.preview: We found your stream key in public and revoked it to protect your channel.
streamKeyRevoked.heading: We revoked a leaked stream key
streamKeyRevoked.body: We found the stream key for {channel} in a public place and revoked it so nobody else can stream to your channel.
streamKeyRevoked.next: Create a new stream key and update it in your streaming software before you go live again.
streamKeyRevoked.tip: Never show your stream key on stream or share it in screenshots.
